# NLP501-bench v1.1: v1 re-scored with blind human labels (generated by `python -m app.eval.benchmark_v1_1`; do not edit by hand)

Human labels: Hoa and Phúc, blind, 120 pairs of `ours` (every pair the two silver annotators disagreed on, plus controls), merged with the Djinni rule (equal → kept, one apart → lower). 120 pairs used, 0 left at silver (people ≥ 2 apart); the human grade differs from the silver mean on 100 of them (the silver grade is a mean of two models, often a half grade). `coding` keeps its rubric labels. Both columns score the same stored rankings, the ones in `.runtime/eval/results*` today: systems re-run after the v4.1 fixes differ from the frozen v1 report (BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md, 31 Oct), so the v1 column here is v1's labels on today's rankings. v1 itself is unchanged.
